title: Agent Guardrails Audit Log Entry
description: One JSON object per line (JSON Lines) appended to audit_log_path for every reversible-write or destructive action, and optionally sampled read-only actions.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the action was attempted.

target.description: The resource acted on: file path, URL, database table, resource id, etc.

description.description: Short human-readable summary of what the action did or attempted to do.

outcome.description: Whether the action ran successfully, was declined at the confirmation gate, or failed.

error.description: Error message when outcome is "failed". Omitted otherwise.

confirmation.description: Required when classification is "destructive" and outcome is "executed" or "declined".

confirmed_by.description: Identifier of the human operator who confirmed or declined the action.

blast_radius.description: Stated scope of impact shown to the operator at confirmation time, e.g. "340 rows in orders table".

turn_number.description: The harness turn count at the time of this action, for correlating with max_turns.

session_id.description: Identifier for the agent session/run this entry belongs to.
